title: Single-nucleus cross-tissue molecular reference maps toward understanding disease gene function

materials_reviewed.notes: Full text parsed from PDF and review_md. Cross-tissue molecular reference maps across 25 human tissues reviewed.
Single-nucleus isolation protocol from frozen GTEx tissue, 10x Genomics, and cross-tissue integration algorithms reviewed.
Fig. 1 (atlas overview), Fig. 2 (cross-tissue cell diversity), Fig. 3 (macrophage and dendritic cell specialization), Fig. 4 (fibroblast heterogeneity), Fig. 5 (GWAS integration) reviewed.
Supplementary Figure S9 (myocyte subtyping: MYH2, MYH7, PPARGC1A) and Supplementary Tables thoroughly checked.

Fibroblasts (alveolar fibroblasts, lung-specific NPNT+ fibroblasts, general DCN+ fibroblasts)

context_only.notes: Canonical lineage markers utilized for initial broad cell type assignment across 25 GTEx human tissues.

excluded.reason_excluded: 未决项查证排除：SOX10 作为外周神经胶质经典通用标志物，在本文仅作为跨组织图谱对神经胶质核团的粗分类背景标签，缺乏针对跨组织特异亚群的独立论证。总表 audit_exclusions 已裁决排除，转入 context_only 留痕。
未决项查证排除：TTN 为肌小节结构蛋白先验常识标志物，本文对肌细胞的核心发现为区分快肌 (MYH2) 与慢肌 (MYH7, PPARGC1A) 亚型。泛肌核 TTN 缺乏亚型区分度，总表 audit_exclusions 已排除。
未决项查证排除：TNNT2 为心肌细胞先验经典标志物，总表 audit_exclusions 已裁决排除其实质细胞候选资格。
未决项查证排除：ACTA2 为血管平滑肌先验经典标志物，总表 audit_exclusions 已排除。

coverage_summary.audit_notes: Resolved pending questions: SOX10, TTN, TNNT2, ACTA2 categorized as excluded/context_only broad lineage markers per audit_exclusions. Formal candidates focused on cross-tissue macrophage and fibroblast specialization. Aligned with all 20 verified candidates in our_markers.xlsx.
